title: RRSRCH LibraryItem
description: Frozen contract for a library item (ROADMAP §4). Source of truth: validate.mjs derives required fields, enums, and bounds from this file. NOTE (v0 reconciliation): v0 seed files carry `updated` (a date) as the freshness signal; ROADMAP §4 names `createdAt`/`updatedAt`. To keep the seed library valid while freezing the §4 superset, `updated` is required and the §4 timestamps + evolution fields (confidence, brief, supersedes, related, provenance, embedding) are OPTIONAL — later phases populate them.

confidence.description: 0..1 — how sure we are this is true/current. Optional in v0.

always.description: do-not-break; reserved into every pack for its project (subject to the always-cap).

brief.description: Precomputed compressed form (the Brief layer). Optional in v0.

provenance.description: Optional in v0; defaults to manual.
